استرققن (form X)
# اِسْتَرْقَقْنَ (istarqaqna) /is.tar.qaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرَقَّ (istaraqqa)
# اُسْتُرْقِقْنَ (usturqiqna) /us.tur.qiq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرَقَّ (istaraqqa)
# اِسْتَرْقِقْنَ (istarqiqna) /is.tar.qiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرَقَّ (istaraqqa)
